WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE c.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND c.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format, cs.region,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS per_day, ctl.ctl_net, ss.net_sales - ctl.ctl_net AS gap
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctl ON ctl.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank

WITH s AS (
  SELECT f.sale_date AS d, SUM(f.net_amount) AS gross_sales, COUNT(*) AS n, COUNT(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS nd, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS nid,
         MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) AS min_load, MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) AS max_load
  FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
r AS (
  SELECT r.return_date AS d, SUM(r.refund_net) AS ret FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  WHERE s.store_id=116 AND r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-08-25' AND DATE '2025-09-21' GROUP BY 1),
c AS (SELECT business_date d, net_sales_before_returns nb, returns_net rn, net_sales ns, receipts FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=116)
SELECT s.d, s.gross_sales, s.n, s.nd, s.nid, s.min_load::VARCHAR, s.max_load::VARCHAR, r.ret, c.nb, c.rn, c.ns, s.gross_sales-c.nb AS diff
FROM s LEFT JOIN r USING(d) LEFT JOIN c USING(d) ORDER BY 1

WITH params AS (
    SELECT DATE '2025-08-25' AS start_date, DATE '2025-09-21' AS end_date
),
period_days AS (
    SELECT d.calendar_date FROM dim_date d CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE d.calendar_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND d.is_trading_day
),
trading_days AS (
    SELECT cs.store_id, COUNT(*) AS trading_days
    FROM dim_store cs
    CROSS JOIN period_days pd
    WHERE cs.is_current AND cs.store_id < 900
      AND (cs.open_date IS NULL OR cs.open_date <= pd.calendar_date)
      AND (cs.close_date IS NULL OR cs.close_date >= pd.calendar_date)
      AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ref_store_closure c
                      WHERE c.store_id = cs.store_id AND pd.calendar_date BETWEEN c.closure_start_date AND c.closure_end_date)
    GROUP BY 1
),
sales_dedup AS (
    SELECT * FROM fact_sales_line
    QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY receipt_id, line_no ORDER BY sales_line_id) = 1
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT f.sale_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM sales_dedup f
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s   ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id < 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
),
store_sales AS (
    SELECT n.store_id, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales
    FROM net_lines n CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date
    GROUP BY 1
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT c.store_id, SUM(c.net_sales) AS ctl_net
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales c CROSS JOIN params
    WHERE c.business_date BETWEEN params.start_date AND params.end_date AND c.store_id < 900
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ss.net_sales / td.trading_days DESC) AS rank, cs.store_id, cs.store_name, cs.format,
       td.trading_days, ss.net_sales, ROUND(ss.net_sales / td.trading_days, 0) AS net_sales_per_trading_day,
       ss.net_sales - ctl.ctl_net AS gap, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM fact_sales_line) - (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sales_dedup) AS dup_rows_total
FROM store_sales ss
JOIN trading_days td ON td.store_id = ss.store_id
JOIN dim_store cs    ON cs.store_id = ss.store_id AND cs.is_current
LEFT JOIN ctl ON ctl.store_id = ss.store_id
ORDER BY rank
